terms.gloss: a sufficiency, abundance; the state of having had enough or too much: fullness, satiety, weariness of a thing
evidence: Plaut. Poen. 1.2.6: neque ūlla ōrnandī satis satietās est (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: jūcunditātemque vīctūs esse in dēsīderiō, nōn in satietāte
phrases.english: and that the pleasure of food lies in wanting it, not in being full
